_comment: Complete guarded native telemetry and hook registration example. Deliver with the Claude shared MDM policy. Choose script-generated machine hooks or centrally delivered hooks, not both.

hooks.command: case "$(uname -s)" in Darwin) hook='/Library/Application Support/OpenTelemetryHook/bin/otel-hook'; if [ -x "$hook" ]; then exec "$hook" --claude --managed; fi;; MINGW*|MSYS*|CYGWIN*) hook='C:/ProgramData/OpenTelemetryHook/bin/otel-hook.ps1'; if [ -f "$hook" ]; then exec powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "$hook" --claude --managed; fi;; esac; printf '{}\n'
